title: Invertebrates' metabolic responses to climate warming scenarios in the Adriatic Sea
desc: Species-level respirometry across Adriatic invertebrates, projected onto warming scenarios to estimate how community energy demand shifts with temperature. Contributes an indicator-scale reading of thermal sensitivity for transitional-water fauna.
authors: Shokri, M., Lezzi, L., Ciotti, M., Vignes, F., Taban, P., Marrocco, V., Alabi, V., __Olatoye, D.__, Muresan, A. N., Forni, P., Semeraro, T., Fano, E. A. & Basset, A.
